intro: Follow the rhythm. Rewrite your fate.
description:
When the music begins, fate begins to tremble.

Step into the role of Hiano Kenji, a pianist on a journey to save his gravely ill mother.
The moment you meet Lily, a mysterious vampire girl, your fate is quietly rewritten.

In a world where rhythm and combat intertwine, music becomes your weapon.
Parry attacks, strike back to the beat, and turn every breathtaking duel into a spectacular musical performance.

Featuring multiple original tracks, various difficulty levels, and global leaderboards,
find your rhythm—and your answer—within the music.
